reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Iconbuddy (https://iconbuddy.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看具名折线与尺寸，再核原源版本和许可。

Visual details from source observation: 我们看网格里的闹钟、对齐与 Activity 折线，再进单图页看尺寸、色板和输出控件。建议选图后核对原图标集及版本，当前只取得一份 SVG，没有操作变色或导出按钮。这个入口适合按库找同类图稿，Lucide Activity 免费单图与 Pro 功能分开；提供件缺到精确上游版本的许可链，许可和商用仍未知，不能借平台 ISC 或图形相似扩大授权。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
